rows.note: This is the neutral, all-purpose choice for a person from another country.

example.traditional: 嗰個外國人識講廣東話。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.note: Use this colloquial term mainly for a Western foreign man, rather than for foreigners generally.

example.english: That foreigner comes to this bar all the time.
example.traditional: 嗰個鬼佬成日嚟呢間酒吧。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gwai2 lou2 sing4 jat6 lai4 ni1 gaan1 zau2 baa1

rows.note: Use this casual term when speaking informally about a foreigner, with a less neutral tone than 外國人.

example.english: The foreigner next to me can speak a few words of Cantonese.
example.traditional: 我隔籬個老外識講幾句廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaak3 lei4 go3 lou5 ngoi6 sik1 gong2 gei2 geoi3 gwong2 dung1 waa2
